method.transcriptBytes: UTF-8 bytes of the normalized plain transcript (NFC, LF, per-line whitespace rules, blank-line collapse) per the plan's normative normalization, computed from the rendered capture rows in source order
method.timestampedTranscriptBytes: UTF-8 bytes of the normalized timestamped form, serialized one line per row as "[verbatim .transcript-time] .transcript-text"
method.serializedJobBytes: UTF-8 length of compact canonical TranscriptJob JSON (schema property order, standard escaping, no insignificant whitespace) with real sample values
method.nativeMessageBytes: UTF-8 length of the complete compact submit_job JSON payload including a worst-case 64-character requestId envelope, excluding the four-byte frame prefix
method.statusPageBytes: UTF-8 length of a compact status response containing 50 worst-case bounded JobSummary objects (max-length lectureKey 128, targetPath 512, lastErrorCategory 64, longest status string, 20-digit counts), full worst-case counts object for all 15 keys, and max-length auth fields (64-char userCode, two 2048-byte HTTPS URIs); identical worst-case construction for every sample
method.sample2: sample 2 comes from the live lecture-02 observation, which recorded raw DOM-derived UTF-8 text sizes but not the full text. Its values are upper bounds: raw pre-normalization sizes for the two transcript fields (normalization only removes whitespace on this content, and NFC was verified to be a no-op on sample 1), plus the sample-1 JSON escape overhead ratio (0.040852) applied and the same fixed envelope/field overhead, rounded up

capCheck.renderTimeMs: pending live measurement; both live observations showed the populated transcript appearing immediately after the activation click, with no stall observed

renderTimeMeasurement.definition: activation (transcript control click) through the second matching stable snapshot, measured per sample on a real permitted page
renderTimeMeasurement.recipe: With the lecture page open and DevTools console running, paste the snippet from docs/STAGE_0_REPORT.md (section 'Render-time measurement'), click Show Transcript, and read the printed milliseconds. Record the value for both samples and replace the null renderTimeMs entries.
renderTimeMeasurement.failCriteria: if any supported sample reaches 30000ms or times out, Stage 0 fails and the plan must be revised before implementation

queueModeChecks.databaseDirectoryMode: 0700 (contract value; verified at Stage 4 acceptance when the directory is created)
queueModeChecks.databaseFileModes: 0600 for queue.sqlite3, its WAL, and SHM files (contract value; verified at Stage 4 acceptance)
queueModeChecks.logFileMode: 0600, rotation at 5 MiB across at most three files (contract value; verified at Stage 4 acceptance)
queueModeChecks.singleInstance: advisory flock LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB on queue.lock, fd held for process lifetime; second process exits already_running (contract value; verified at Stage 4 acceptance)
